notes.title: 🌸 Spring Tales Demo Update V1.0.4
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
We’ve just released a small update for the Spring Tales demo. This patch focuses on polishing the overall experience, making puzzles clearer, and smoothing out the dialogue flow. Thank you so much for all the feedback so far, it really helps us improve the game![/p][h3]What’s new:[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted puzzle difficulty for a smoother flow[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dialogue text speed and readability[/p][/*][*][p]Added better hints and guidance in certain puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced UI/visual feedback during interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor visual and stability issues[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope this makes the demo more enjoyable and easier to follow. If you haven’t already, don’t forget to [b]wishlist Spring Tales[/b], it really supports the development and helps us a lot 💖[/p][p]Thanks for playing and sharing your thoughts with us![/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE V1.0.3
notes.content:
[h3][h1]Here’s what’s new in the latest update:[/h1][/h3]

[list]
[*] The street background has been redrawn in a higher resolution, with some technical issues fixed along the way.
[*] Dialogue bubbles are now flexible and show the full text at once instead of breaking it into pieces.
[*] The typing sound for dialogue has been slowed down, and we’ve added the same effect to the intro scene.
[*] Puzzle indicators are now easier to notice.
[*] You can now pause the game anytime using the ESC key – a proper pause system has been added.
[*] Fixed a bug where the background music would sometimes overlap or not play.
[*] Nadine’s grandmother’s portrait has been redrawn, and some technical improvements were made.
[/list]

Thanks for playing and supporting Spring Tales! 🌸
Let us know if you run into any bugs or issues, We’re always listening!

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE V1.0.1
notes.content:
✨ Spring Tales Demo Update! ✨

Based on your feedback, we've made several improvements to the demo! Here's what's new:

🔹 Reduced install size & improved optimization
🔹 Fixed the pancake bug in the breakfast table scene
🔹 Fixed an issue where muffins wouldn’t come out of their cup in the special recipe puzzle
🔹 Made the cream piping step for muffins clearer
🔹 Improved recipe book visuals for better clarity
🔹 Fixed several music transition issues
🔹 Increased dialogue bubble size for better readability
🔹 Fixed various menu button issues

Thank you for playing & sharing your feedback! 💛 Let us know what you think of the update! 🌸✨
